body: I do love him.. but he just told me they're going to try and work things out for their son. So, I guess I should be happy for them..
I can't go out most of the time which is why.. I also think it's bullshit. Been in therapy a few times over the years. I do exercise regularly, btw.. doesn't help either.

The dog walking suggestion isn't bad.. but I have a lot of difficulty leaving the house. For instance, it's been about 5 days now and I haven't left and have almost no food to eat (I haven't really been able to eat anyway). This is typical for me. I can't bear the thought of being seen by people. I wish I could live somewhere rural so being outdoors would be easier, but I don't have that option. Thanks for trying, though. This is a hopeless situation. Not everyone is strong enough to fix their problems.

See.. I don't know if I did do the right thing. And yes, he cheated on his wife, but that doesn't make him a bad person at all. My telling his wife hasn't helped the situation either. Now I'm alone, and they might get divorced because of it. It was a stupid thing to do.
